raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the person who died later necessarily lived longer, using death year as a proxy for lifespan despite different birth years. This flawed logic contradicted the already established ages (Henry Scheffé ~70 years vs. Csaba Pálinkás ~45 years) and led to the wrong conclusion that Csaba lived longer.
